acceptanceCriteria: `ticket search --help` (and other reads) return OK with usage and filter names.
A CLI test covers --help for every implemented read command.
body:
Reproduction: `corvint-tasks ticket search --help`. Actual (verbatim): {"codes":["MALFORMED"],"command":["ticket","search"],"items":[],"outcome":"ERROR",...,"warnings":["MALFORMED: argv: unknown flag --help"]}. Expected: help listing the filters (status, kind, priority, owner, milestone, label, text, offset, limit), as `ticket create --help` does for its payload. Also check other read commands.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).

title: corvint-tasks ticket search --help returns MALFORMED instead of help
